description: Use when you need a record you can keep or hand to someone else, for example when a reviewer, auditor or counterparty asks why a payment to this address was allowed or refused. Returns everything OceanAlt holds about an address as public facts, in one Ed25519-signed bundle you can verify offline: screening verdict with evidence and freshness, profile signals, one-hop relations to listed addresses, fulfillment receipt stats and coverage. The response includes the signature and the key URL (https://oceanalt.com/.well-known/oceanalt-keys.json) to verify it. A witness, not a prosecutor: no conclusions about people. It does not return a pay / do-not-pay decision. Same as GET https://oceanalt.com/api/evidence/bundle. Free, no API key.

address.description: The address to bundle evidence for. Accepts the same formats as screen_address (EVM 0x…, Tron T…, Solana, Bitcoin, XRP Ledger and others).

name: evidence_bundle
title: Signed evidence bundle for an address (free)
